bib.title: ARC-AGI-2: A New Challenge for Frontier AI Reasoning Systems

question: How can ARC-AGI-1's limits (brute-force susceptibility, no first-party human data, saturation, leakage) be fixed in a harder, human-calibrated successor?
hypothesis: Compositionally harder, human-calibrated tasks keep human solvability while giving a finer signal on AI fluid reasoning.
contributions: New task set keeping ARC-AGI-1 format with more complex, compositional tasks

method.summary: Candidate tasks (newly authored plus unused reserves) were human-tested in 3 live sessions, filtered by solve rates, deduplicated, and split into difficulty-matched eval sets. Frontier models were scored on the Semi-Private set via a public baseline repo.
